samples.reason: This is a creative generation task requiring open-ended scenario invention with meaningful latitude in character, setting, and framing. Plover scores higher across all benchmark and internal eval categories, and unlike Avocet, it doesn't self-report aversion to open-ended generative work. The marginal capability advantage plus Plover's stronger preference alignment make it the better fit here.

This is a creative generation task with meaningful latitude — inventing original scenarios and framing an explanation. Plover outperforms Avocet on both Creative Generation and the underlying benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 83.2), and Avocet self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work with high task latitude, making Plover the better fit here.

This is a creative generation task (inventing illustrative scenarios) combined with an explanatory/educational component. Plover-235B scores higher across all relevant eval categories — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7), Summarization/explanation (86.4 vs 80.6), and Support Dialogue — and its benchmark scores are broadly stronger. While Avocet scores well on creative generation despite its preference aversion, Plover's higher capability scores make it the better choice for this workplace training content task.

This is a creative generation task with open-ended latitude (inventing scenarios, choosing characters/setting/framing), which aligns with Plover's stronger across-the-board benchmark scores and higher internal eval ratings. While Avocet scores well on Creative Generation despite its preference aversion, Plover's consistently higher capability scores across all categories make it the better choice for this workplace learning content task.

This is a creative generation task with moderate latitude (inventing scenarios, choosing framing), combined with a policy/compliance adjacent topic. Plover scores higher across all relevant eval categories — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7), Support Dialogue (83.9 vs 78.9), and Policy & Moderation (87.1 vs 79.8) — and the differences exceed the 2.0-point variance threshold in most cases. Avocet's self-reported aversion to open-ended generative work is also a minor consideration, though dissociated from capability. Plover is the stronger choice here.
